Commentary.Commentary: Right then, we are done with this one-sided match! There is no rest for the players as the next T20I is on Sunday, 8th November 2020 at 1530 local (1030 GMT). We look forward to your company. Goodbye and cheers!

Victorious skipper and also the MAN OF THE MATCH, Babar Azam says he is satisfied with the performance and enjoys his batting. Adds that he bats according to the situation. Mentions that after the last loss this win will give them confidence. Shares that they stuck to the plans with the ball and there was some help for the bowlers. States that they want to play the right combination and they are giving opportunities to the bench strength so that they will have some experience before the T20 World Cup. Admits that they have to work on their fielding and catching.

Zimbabwe skipper, Chamu Chibhabha says that they were 20 runs short of the total they wanted. Adds that in the middle period and middle overs they need to do a lot more and credits the middle order for doing well. Praises Wesley Madhevere for batting superbly. Mentions that they pride themselves in the field and this is something to improve on as they were not up to the mark. On Madhevere, Chamu says that is pleasing to watch, plays some beautiful shots and a very promising youngster.

Not a lot to talk about Zimbabwe's bowling. Tendai Chisoro and Blessing Muzarabani were the only bowlers to keep things tidy but they didn't receive much support from the other bowlers. All in all, a bad day at the office for them where their batting unit also flopped. If it was not for Madhevere's knock, the visitors would not have even crossed the 150-run mark. Stay tuned for the presentation...

Zimbabwe did manage to pick a couple of wickets in the first 8 overs but never managed to put any kind of pressure. Babar Azam's presence meant that the runs kept on flowing and along with Mohammad Hafeez, he put the chase to bed with an 80-run stand. They both got out towards the end but at that time, only formalities were left in the chase.

Easy win for Pakistan, just like it was supposed to be! The target could have been tricky had they lost early wickets but Zimbabwe failed to do the early damage and the hosts got off to a flying start. It was a cruise for them from there onward.

NOT OUT! That's it! Pakistan win! Good length ball on the pads, Rizwan looks to swing it away but misses and gets hit on the pads. Zimbabwe appeal but nothing from the umpire as the batsmen cross. Zimbabwe take the review. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it shows that it is going down leg. PAKISTAN WIN BY 6 WICKETS.
Review time! Pakistan have taken a review for LBW. It is more in desperation and to delay Pakistan's victory. Looks like it is going down the leg side. Yes, it is.
Good length ball outside off, Rizwan defends it to covers. Two dots.
Full on middle, Rizwan defends it back to the bowler.
Mohammad Rizwan is the next man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Action and drama in the middle, just 1 needed and Hafeez departs. Good piece of bowling from Muzarabani. Length ball on off, angling in. Hafeez looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the stumps.
FOUR LEG BYES! Poor line from Blessing. He bowls a length ball on the pads, Hafeez looks to flick but it takes his pads and goes to the fine leg fence for four leg byes.
Blessing Muzarabani will bowl now.
Full on middle, Hafeez flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Just over the mid off fielder. 150 up for Pakistan. Just 6 needed now for Pakistan. Slower one outside off, Hafeez lifts it over mid off where the fielder jumps to catch but it goes over.
Full on middle, Khushdil works it wide of the long on region for a single.
FOUR! Thrashed! Khushdil picked the bones out of that. He loves playing that shot. Short ball on middle, Shah pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, Khushdil pulls but finds mid-wicket. Two dots in a row.
Full on off, Shah pushes it to mid off.
Khushdil Shah is the next man in. Richard Ngarava is back into the attack.

OUT! CAUGHT! Azam falls after playing a magnificent knock. He failed to pick the slower ball and perishes. Do Zimbabwe still have a chance? Slower ball on middle, Azam looks to hammer it over deep mid-wicket but does not get it off the middle. It goes flying in the deep where Madhevere runs ahead and takes a simple catch. 15 needed from 18 balls.
Very full on off, Hafeez digs it out towards the off side for a single.
Fullish ball on off, Azam drives it to cover and crosses over for a single.
Short ball on middle, Azam pulls it to deep mid-wicket and a fumble from the fielder allows the batsmen to take a couple.
Slower ball on off, Hafeez waits for it and then plays it to long on for a run.
Full on middle, Azam pushes it down to long on for a single.
Tendai Chatara is back on.
Good length ball outside off, punched to deep cover for a single.
Length ball on the pads, Azam tucks it to deep square leg and picks up a couple.
Back of a length ball on middle, Hafeez works it to fine leg for a single.
Full on middle, Hafeez looks to heave but it takes the inside half of the bat and goes towards mid-wicket.
Length ball on middle, Hafeez works it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Hafeez lets it go. Wided.
Full on the pads, Azam flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Blessing Muzarabani is back on. 2-0-20-1 are his figures so far.
Knocks a full ball down to long on for a run. 13 from the over, 27 needed more.
FOUR! Easy pickings! The line is on middle and leg, probably another carom ball going wrong, Babar sweeps it behind square leg and fetches a boundary.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps this one through mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! This one has gone all the way! Short in length and on middle, Hafeez hangs on the back foot and launches it over square leg.
Nails it very full and on middle, Hafeez digs it out back.
Floated and full around off, it's driven through cover-point for a run.
Yet another single on the leg side as the ball travels in the gap at mid-wicket. Chisoro is done for the evening, good figures for him.
Fullish and on middle, worked to mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! The pressure is released! Chisoro tries another yorker but it turns out to be a low full toss and Hafeez drives it through extra cover for a boundary. 50-run stand is up!
Quicker, flatter and shorter outside off, Hafeez plays it down to point. Three dots.
Hits the yorker mark on middle, Professor squeezes it out safely on the off side.
Walks down the track and yorks himself. Hafeez then digs it out and the ball loops up for a while. The bowler runs ahead but it drops safely.
Raza goes flatter and delivers it on middle, it's eased through mid-wicket for one. Six singles in the over along with a dropped catch.

DROPPED! Muzarabani puts down a sitter! A flighted full ball on off, Babar jumps down the track and hammers it over mid off. It's a simple catch going into the lap of Blessing but he spills it. A run taken.
A mishit! Tossed up ball on middle, Hafeez kneels for the slog sweep but it takes the inner half and rolls behind square leg for a run.
Uses the turn and tucks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Presses forward and pushes it through covers for a run.
Too full in length on off, Babar forces his drive to covers for a single.
Sikandar Raza is on now.
Flatter and fuller on middle, Babar helps it to mid-wicket and crosses.
FOUR! Firmly cut! Short in length and outside off, Babar rocks back and spanks it behind point for a cracking boundary.
Eases a full ball down to long on for another run.
Confusion again but no harm done! Babar uses his feet on this occasion and drills a full ball down towards long on. Sikandar does well to make the stop. They take a run only.
Fires a full ball on middle, it's flicked through square leg for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Hafeez cuts it to deep point and takes a run. Confusion over the second run and they decide not to cross eventually.
Tendai Chisoro is back on. 2-0-11-0 are his figures so far.
Skidding down the leg side, it's clipped towards fine leg for a run. 11 from the over, 61 needed more.
Tossed up ball on middle, helped with gentle hands in front of square on the leg side. Good enough to come back for the second run.
FOUR! Shot! Quicker and flatter around off, a touch on the shorter side too, Babar gets back and slaps it past short third man. The fielder chases but fails to pull it back cleanly.

Misfield! Short and outside off, Hafeez cuts it to point where the fielder misfields as it spins past him. The sweeper cover fielder, Chisoro, does well near the fence to pull it back. Saves a run for his side as the third umpire finds it to be a fair stop.
Presses forward to a full ball and pushes it to covers. Dot ball.
FIFTY FOR BABAR, 15th in T20Is! Gets there by punching a flatter ball on off towards extra cover and calls his partner for a quick run.
Sean Williams is into the attack.
Shortish on middle, Azam pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Pakistan need 72 in 10 overs.
Full and outside off, Hafeez times it beautifully but straight to deep cover. A single taken.
Full on middle, Azam pushes it to mid off for a single.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Azam is in full flow at the moment. Back of a length ball outside off, Azam cuts it through the cover-point region for a boundary.
SIX! Azam makes full use of the Free Hit! This has class written all over it. Perfect timing. Full on middle, Azam lifts it over long on for a maximum.
Short ball around middle, Hafeez pulls it to deep square leg for a single. Ngarava has overstepped and it is a NO BALL. A Free Hit will follow.
Good length ball on middle, Azam works it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! What a shot! Nobody moved. Floated outside off, Hafeez comes down the track and then hammers it past the extra cover fielder for a boundary.
On off, forced to point for a single.
Full on off, Hafeez pushes it down to long off for a run.
Loopy ball on off, Hafeez drives it to cover.
EDGY! Floated on off, Hafeez dances down the track and then looks to heave it but it takes the inside edge and hits the pads.
Flatter ball outside off, Hafeez guides it to short third man.
Hafeez is off the mark. Good length ball on middle, Hafeez flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Mohammad Hafeez comes out to bat. He is in prolific recent form, averaging in excess of 90 in his last 10 innings. What an asset to have in the middle order!

OUT! CAUGHT! What a ripper of a delivery from Ngarava and a terrific catch from Brendan Taylor. Good length ball on off, shaping away. Haider Ali looks to flick but closes the face of the bat early and edges to the right of the keeper. Taylor dives to that side and takes a wonderful one-handed catch. The appeal is made and the finger is up. Haider walks. Pakistan need 95 in 73 balls.
FOUR! Hammered! First boundary for Haider Ali. Ngarava bowls it short but does not rise enough. Haider waits for it and then pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, Haider pulls but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length ball on middle, Haider tucks it to mid-wicket.
Short ball on middle, Azam works it to deep square leg for a single.
Richard Ngarava is back on.
Floated ball on off, Azam drives it to deep cover for a run.
Flatter and outside off, Haider tucks it to cover for a single.
Outside off, Azam plays it to the off side for another run.
Flatter outside off, Haider punches it to deep cover for a single.
Full on middle, Azam works it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Floated on middle, Azam defends it back to the bowler.
Tendai Chisoro is into the attack.
Full on middle, Azam works it to mid on for a single. Pakistan are 52 for 1 at the end of the Powerplay. They need 105 to win from 84 balls.
FOUR! Poor stuff from Chatara. He bowls this on the pads of Azam who flicks this nonchalantly through square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Don't bowl there to Azam. He will hit you all day. Short and outside off, Azam punches it through the extra cover region for a boundary.
Full on middle, Ali works it to down to long on for a single.
An appeal for LBW turned down. Very full on middle, Haider works it to short fine leg. An appeal is made by Brendan Taylor but it is turned down.
Full on the pads, Azam flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Tendai Chatara is back on. 1-0-8-0 are his figures so far.
Slices a length ball over point and the third man fielder rushes across to his right to make a sliding stop. A single taken and Pakistan are 41/1 after 5 overs.
Almost edges it behind! Back of a length ball on off, angling away, Babar tries to play it late down to third man but misses.
FOUR! Up and just over mid on! Full length ball on middle, Babar tries to lift it over the bowler's head but it takes the inside half and balloons over the leaping in-ring fielder for a boundary.
Shortish and on off, Babar punches it from the back foot towards cover-point. Fails to beat the fielder though.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.
Beaten! A very full ball outside off, angling away, Babar tries to dig it out but misses.
Haider Ali is the next man in. Richard Ngarava is into the attack.

OUT! A disappointing end to what was looking a good knock! Back of a length ball on middle, Fakhar stays back and tries to power his shot over the leg side. But the ball bounces a tad more on his bat and takes the top edge. Chigumbura settles underneath it at mid on and takes the catch despite being off-balance. 121 needed off 96 balls.
On a length around middle and off, Fakhar punches it from the crease to covers.
SIX! Down the wicket comes Fakhar Zaman and boom! A slower length ball on middle and off, Fakhar shimmies down the track and clobbers it over wide long on for a biggie.
Shortish and on off, Babar runs it down to third man for a run.
Sensibly works a length ball on the leg side, it finds the gap at mid-wicket and crosses.
FOUR! Feed him width and suffer. This one is nicely short and wide outside off for the batsman, Fakhar needs no second invitation as he rocks back and smashes it through point.
This time the line is straight and the length is good, Fakhar pushes it a bit uppishly in the direction of mid on and takes a run. 8 from the over, once again, for the third over in a row!
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Zaman punches it from the back foot to covers.
Fuller length ball around off, Azam eases it past his partner at the other end. Since the fielder is dropped back, only a run this time.
Mid on drops back. Third man comes up.
FOUR! That's not the length to bowl to Babar Azam. It's short and around off, Azam remains put inside the crease and hammers his pull over mid on.
Shortish and outside off, Babar stands tall inside the crease and punches it square of the wicket on the off side for a couple of runs.
Good length ball on middle, Babar plays it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Another glorious drive from the bat of Babar Azam. This time it's straight back past the bowler and the mid off fielder cuts it off. They cross.
Tendai Chatara is into the attack.
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side, Azam tries flicking but misses.
Short and wide outside off, Babar under edges his attempted square cut. It goes behind to the keeper.
FOUR! Wow, what an eye-catching shot! Blessing pitches it up and around off, Babar creams his drive through the gap between mid off and covers for a glorious boundary.
Angling into the batsman, Babar tries to work it around but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.

DROPPED! That would have been a stunner had Chibhabha caught it. Muzarabani angles across a back of a length ball outside off, Fakhar goes for a full-blooded drive through the line but gets a fat outside edge. It goes to the left of Chibhabha at first slip who reacts in that direction but fails to hang on to the catch. The batsmen cross.
Short in length and outside off, Babar guides it down to third man and takes a single.
Blessing Muzarabani will bowl from the other end. He bowled superbly in the last ODI. Can he repeat his performance here?
Quicker one on the pads, helped in the gap on the leg side for a run. 8 from the first over!
Whoa! First ball and Zaman jumps down the track immediately. Attempts a big heave but fails to connect. It goes off his pads to short third man. Babar Azam has a word with his partner.
FOUR! Lovely timing! The delivery is on the fuller side of the length and the line is on the leg stump, Zaman picks it off his pads flicks it past the square leg fielder for a boundary.
A flighted delivery landing full on middle, Babar pushes it through mid on and opens his account with a single.
Flatter and on middle, Zamah this time stays back and eases it down to long on for a single.
Whoa! First ball and Zaman jumps down the track immediately. Attempts a big heave but fails to connect. It goes off his pads to short third man. Babar Azam has a word with his partner.
We are all set to begin the run chase. The Zimbabwe players are out in the middle, followed by Babar Azam and Fakhar Zaman. Wesley Madhevere will start with the ball.
